about: Review records for the chant scores. A score whose GABC no longer hashes to gabcSha256 has changed since a person checked it.

entries.explanation: Ordered comparison with the hymn text: the score has 80 words, the text 93. Not in the score: the doxology stanza (Deo Patri sit gloria … in saeculorum saecula) and the words 'qui a mortuis surrexit'; the rest differ only in spelling (caritas/charitas, dextrae/dexterae) or are a different reading (dei/tu te). This is a partial score of the hymn, not a corrupt one. Not checked against the printed Liber Hymnarius.
entries.reviewMethod: Ordered word-by-word comparison with hymns.json (scripts/chant/review.mjs). Not checked against the printed book named in the source header.
